item.title: Kentucky uses dominant second half to down Indiana; picks up first quality win of the season
item.description: LEXINGTON, Ky. (ABC 36 NEWS NOW) – The Kentucky Wildcats earned their first win against a quality opponent this season, defeating Indiana 72–60.
